note: Re-checked against the managing agencies' own pages for this release. Each statement is quoted, with its URL and the date it was read; the page text is not republished. A statement applies only to the units listed in appliesTo. Anything not listed as verified is excluded from the public explorer, with the reason recorded in `review`.
publisherNote: Quotations are short extracts used to support a factual claim, with attribution.

shawnee-nf.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Shawnee National Forest
shawnee-nf.summary: Overnight parking is permitted where posted, such as trailheads, for overnight camping; day-use areas signed 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. are closed to overnight parking.
shawnee-nf.quote: When camping overnight be sure you park where overnight parking is allowed, such as trailheads and do not block roads or gates. Areas signed as Day-Use Areas - open 6am to 10pm are closed to overnight parking.

states.nightWindow: overnight parking where posted, such as trailheads; day-use areas closed 22:00-06:00

shawnee-nf.summary: PAD-US records federal ownership and USFS management for this unit. It does not record opening hours.

garden-of-the-gods.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Shawnee National Forest
garden-of-the-gods.summary: The wilderness areas are non-motorized: mechanical and motorized vehicles and equipment are prohibited within wilderness, so the mapped centre is not reachable by vehicle and entry is on foot.
garden-of-the-gods.quote: Mechanical and motorized vehicles and equipment are prohibited within wilderness.

sugar-ridge-fwa.summary: The property page states 24/7 property hours, which permits presence on the property after dark; parking is covered by the same whole-property statement and is not documented separately.
sugar-ridge-fwa.quote: Property hours 24/7. Some activities may have specific open times, especially if there is a draw.

states.nightWindow: 24/7 property hours, with activity-specific exceptions posted at the property

sugar-ridge-fwa.summary: PAD-US records state ownership and Indiana DNR management for this unit. It does not record opening hours.

glendale-fwa.reason: The property page carries an Hours heading but no property access hours in the served page, and no after-dark statement was found.

hovey-lake-fwa.reason: Only office and visitor-centre hours are published; no statement about access after dark.

harmonie.reason: The published Hours block is office hours (9 a.m. to 3 p.m.); no property access hours or after-dark statement were found, and office hours must not be read as access permission.

patoka-lake.reason: PAD-US records a federal reservoir designation; no statement from a managing agency about access after dark was located in this review.

higginson-henry.reason: The Kentucky Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources site returned HTTP 403 to this review, so no statement could be confirmed either way.

wabash-mount-carmel.reason: PAD-US records private ownership and private management with no public permission recorded.

aep-rockport.reason: PAD-US records a public-access flag for this unit while its owner and manager are private; a dataset flag is not permission, so it is excluded.
